column4: Continue the reference: identical camera, framing, pose, face and upward streaming orange hair, but the crack on her cheek has now spread: a main split with two short branches runs from the cheek across to under the eye, a small chip lifted at its edge. Her expression is the same, steely, eyes wide. Same flat pure chroma green (#00B140) background, clean closed outline, no strings, no text.

Same camera and scale as the first reference. The fall has just been caught: her whole body is drawn taut and straight upright, arms pulled up and out above shoulder height, wrists lifted as if jerked by strings, toes pointing straight down, head tipped back slightly, hair and skirt now hanging down heavily. Three-quarter front view. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand; no strings, no controller, no floor, no shadow. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.

Same camera and scale as the reference. She is hanging taut from above, her chest thrust out and turned to the right side of the frame, shoulders twisted, hips swinging to the right, one arm flung out to the right, toes pointing down. Three-quarter view. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.

Same camera and scale as the reference. Opposite of the reference: now her head is jerked sharply to the left side of the frame on a dislocated neck joint, the ball joint at the neck visibly offset, her body hanging with the chest turned slightly left and one arm swung left, toes pointing down. Continue the reference: identical locked camera, workshop and bench, but now the same doll lies flat on her back along the top of the bench, laid out neatly, legs straight, hands at her sides, head toward the left. Keep everything else unchanged. No text.

Continue the reference: identical overhead camera and bench, but now she has a small smile, and her right arm is stretched out toward the camera with the wrist turned up and the hand relaxed, the wrist ring and ball joint plain to see; the other arm still rests by her side. No text.
